sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: The manifest freezes the repository-invocation identity, typed product operation allocation, pre-invocation refusal, operational correlation, and predecessor-ordered recovery contracts before behavior implementation resumes.
allowed_scope: Read the exact manifest subject and named authority only.
Independently recompute vectors and test the recovery/preflight ordering and delta semantics for internal consistency.
Return findings to the parent without editing.
non_goals: Do not implement Rust behavior, edit files, review unrelated implementation, write handoff/ledger/proof, or commit.
tasks: Verify mandatory predecessor-ordered recovery completes before identity resolution, and unsafe recovery returns its own refusal rather than a preflight result.
Verify recovery may perform only effects authorized by the exact recovery tables and those effects remain attributable as prior-transaction recovery rather than current-operation changes.

Verify each preflight branch performs zero native calls, has empty current-operation changed_paths, and creates no new current-operation filesystem, semantic-record, journal, registry, lifecycle, or canonical delta.
Verify the two preflight branches remain closed and disjoint, the operation/token mapping and direct-engine compatibility remain coherent, and all vectors and manifest hashes recompute exactly.
Return CLEAN only if no valid actionable finding remains; classify every finding.
contracts_and_gates: Recovery effects and current-operation effects are distinct and cannot be conflated.
Preflight cannot hide a blocked recovery or authorize effects beyond the exact recovery tables.
After successful recovery, preflight has zero native calls and zero new operation-owned delta; changed_paths is current-operation-only.
Compiler/CLI select only a typed engine operation and accept no identity, raw token, or operation ID.
Behavior resumes only after this different fresh reviewer returns CLEAN.
stop_conditions: Return BLOCKED only for a genuine authority gap outside bounded HCM-2.2 repair.
Do not substitute mutable implementation inspection for contract review.
